summary: Listed prices and WhatsApp booking are strengths, but mixed names, Arabic text on the English page and no doctor names or reviews appear to cost you patients.

findings.problem: The page calls the clinic Dermatology and Aesthetic Clinic, Dermatology and Cosmetic Clinic, Raha Medical Complex, Raha Medical Clinics and Raha Health Services.
findings.cost: Changing names confuse patients and weaken search visibility.

findings.problem: Arabic price labels and Arabic WhatsApp text appear on the English page, the footer booking text mentions a Beauty & Skincare page that does not exist, and two list items are numbered 10 and 11 while the rest are not.
findings.cost: Mixed language and leftover text confuse English speaking patients.

findings.problem: The Location & Working Hours heading has no address or map, the same insurance logo repeats about five times, and many images have no descriptions.
findings.cost: Patients cannot find you easily and the page feels unfinished.
findings.fix: A map with hours and a clean insurance section.

findings.problem: Every Book now button opens WhatsApp with no on site form, and the page shows no named doctors, testimonials or before and after results.
findings.cost: Patients who prefer a form or want proof find neither.
findings.fix: A booking form plus named doctors and results.

redesign: One brand name and clean English and Arabic pages.
A booking form with WhatsApp and a map with hours.
Named doctors, reviews and captioned results.
